host_scope: RTX 4060 Laptop GPU / sm_89 / WSL2 only

authenticity.basis: OP1 Channel-B observed Gemma4RMSNorm in the formal C02-S.O NF4 carrier; 302 calls per model forward and 6,554,910 projected calls over the frozen 11-request workload.

bottleneck.basis: K1 uses the execution card's one-time methodology/correctness-value clause. Direct-scale versus (1+w), fp32 reduction, output cast, and the scale-free v_norm path are correctness traps worth validating independently of speedup.

capability.basis: One Triton program per contiguous flattened row, fp32 reduction, masked power-of-two block, direct optional bf16/fp32 scale, and same-dtype output are implementable on sm_89 with Triton 3.7.1 / Torch 2.13.0+cu130.

deliverability.basis: The wrapper has the same hidden_states -> hidden_states contract and an explicit optional weight, allowing OP3 to replace Gemma4RMSNorm.forward without changing parameters or state_dict keys.

semantics.v_norm_semantics: no learned scale and no weight tensor

execution_card_deviation.reason: OP1 source inspection and formal-carrier module evidence contradict the draft premise

target_population.selection: all census rows; no synthetic shape contributes to formal performance results

semantic_expansion.rule: Each kv_norm_* aggregate is split evenly into k_norm with_scale=true and v_norm with_scale=false; all other variants have with_scale=true.

target_population.expected_layout: contiguous storage with normalized axis stride 1
target_population.timing_weight_policy: Use the named BF16 tensor from the exact C02 artifact for scaled cases; values are data-independent for timing. Scale-free cases pass no weight.

analytic_bytes.fp32_intermediate_location: registers; no intermediate DRAM traffic assumed
analytic_bytes.scale_cache_assumption: Count each scale element once per invocation; Tier-B ncu must supersede this estimate if measured DRAM bytes differ by more than 15%.
analytic_bytes.interpretation_guard: Small decode cases are launch/cache dominated; their DRAM-ceiling relative score is diagnostic, not a standalone bottleneck proof.

eager.definition: Transformers 5.15 Gemma4RMSNorm-equivalent eager PyTorch formula with float32 pow/mean and same-dtype output

compile.definition: torch.compile of the exact eager formula, fullgraph=true, mode=reduce-overhead, dynamic=true

reference.definition: Explicit float32 PyTorch semantic calculation before the final dtype cast
reference.reason: correctness oracle; its fp32 output traffic is not comparable to the formal bf16 carrier

candidate.definition: Triton single-pass row-wise RMSNorm with fp32 reduction and optional direct scale

correctness_protocol.selection: All eight decode semantic cases plus min/p50/max C02-rendered prefill rows for every semantic variant
correctness_protocol.scaled_weight_distribution: uniform(low=-0.5, high=96.0), independently generated per trial
assertions: candidate is allclose to fp32 reference cast to the input dtype
eager is allclose to the same reference
compile is allclose to the same reference
output shape, dtype, contiguity, and finite values match the contract
scale-free path accepts no learned weight

measurement_protocol.interleave_order: three-way rotation by repetition index independently for every formal case

op2_pass_requires: pre-registration hash remains unchanged from process start through receipt write
all source identity hashes and upstream OP0/OP1 PASS states verify
all pre-registered randomized correctness trials pass
all 96 formal performance cases complete with 200 interleaved repetitions per timed implementation
Tier-A analytic roofline fields are present for every formal case
no thermal or hardware throttle is observed
timing memory clock p50 is at least 95% of the OP0 bandwidth-run p50

aggregate_classification.positive: candidate weighted p50 speedup versus compile >= 1.05
aggregate_classification.parity: candidate weighted p50 speedup versus compile >= 0.95 and < 1.05
aggregate_classification.negative: candidate weighted p50 speedup versus compile < 0.95

kill: unresolved correctness after three implementation-fix iterations: kill and retain failure evidence
candidate slower than compile by more than 30% with no bandwidth headroom: record optimization-negative while preserving methodology-gate completion
OP2 plus OP3 exceeds four working days: stop and document
success_and_kill_criteria.ncu_tier_b: Deferred soft gate OP4; currently blocked by Windows ERR_NVGPUCTRPERM and does not block OP2.
